vibe_rationale: Asia's reference zine and art-book fair with a deep, culture-first community and tight curation, but one scene (print and art), so narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Creative audience, mainly in their 20s and 30s, with weak wellness adjacency; a zine or print collaboration or quiet lounge fits. Published sponsors (Sigma, B&O, New Balance, tokyobike) and a contact page make the route open. Tokyo-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
